calls.title: Johnny / Guy
calls.summary: The discussion revolved around refining the user interface to improve clarity and user experience. Key decisions included making settings collapsible for easier navigation, implementing clear 'connected' badges for API hosts and SDK connections, and improving the visibility and accessibility of the client key. The need for better organization within the settings interface was emphasized, with a layout that minimizes visual clutter and enhances usability. Additionally, webhook secrets will be hidden by default to bolster security, and controls for enabling and disabling webhooks are proposed to be moved into a menu to reduce UI clutter. Participants highlighted the importance of clear documentation and user-friendly design, advocating for incremental improvements that prioritize higher impact changes.
calls.keywords: UI design, SDK connection, webhook secrets, proxy, settings collapse, connected status

calls.title: Johnny / Guy
calls.summary: The team discussed essential UI design enhancements aimed at improving usability, particularly in the settings interface and SDK integration. Key decisions included the implementation of collapsible setting blocks to reduce clutter, which allows users to focus on important areas while hiding less-used options. Additionally, connection status indicators were proposed for key elements like the API host to clarify connectivity health. Enhancements to client key visibility were addressed to facilitate user validation, while layout refinements for SDK and webhook settings aimed to streamline navigation. The urgency of redesign completion was deemed low, emphasizing prioritization of more critical tasks. Collaboration with Kari on design details and improved documentation were also highlighted to ensure efficiency in future iterations.
calls.keywords: SDK connection, UI design, collapsible settings, client key visibility, webhook security, proxy connection
